youtube.baslik: How does someone with a cochlear implant hear music? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The implant carries the timing and envelope information needed to understand speech well, but carries pitch information only partly; so rhythm perception is well preserved in most users. Pitch discrimination is often at the level of several semitones; in people with normal hearing it is usually under one semitone. Recognizing a melody without words and telling instruments apart by timbre can also be harder; the aim is not to hear music as before, but to enjoy it again.
